testsuite.name: run.trama.e2e.E2EAsyncCallbackTest

testcase.name: async callback timeout moves saga to failure()
async step receiving non-accepted status code triggers failure path()
valid callback resumes saga to SUCCEEDED()
async node pauses execution in WAITING_CALLBACK state()
callback nonce replay returns 409 on second call()
